summary: Tested the four new sections (Testimonials, Blog/Journal, Team, FAQs) added to Studio Voxel CMS. Backend: 23/23 pytest cases passed covering public seeded GETs, /site/home extension, /dashboard stats extension, 401 on unauthenticated writes, full auth-gated CRUD for testimonials/team/faqs/blog, blog slug auto-generation and slug-based lookup. Frontend: verified homepage testimonials carousel with dot navigation, About team grid, /blog list + /blog/:slug detail navigation, /faq accordion toggle, header Journal/FAQ nav, admin sidebar entries for the four new sections, admin dashboard 8 stat cards, and admin CRUD pages loading with modal Add form. No critical issues found; existing services/projects/gallery admin remain reachable (icon-based edit/delete buttons render).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is nearing 700 lines with heavy repetition across the six CRUD resources (services/projects/gallery/testimonials/team/faqs/blog). Consider a generic CRUD factory to reduce duplication and lower future defect risk.

Blog GET /api/blog returns all posts (including active=False and unpublished). Public detail endpoint correctly filters by active/published — the list endpoint should also filter for the public site to avoid leaking drafts (currently the public /blog page fetches the same endpoint).

slug uniqueness is enforced by a Mongo unique index on blog and projects, but slugify collision on two posts sharing the same title will raise a 500 on insert instead of a 400/409 — consider handling DuplicateKeyError.
dashboard endpoint counts documents including inactive items; may be worth surfacing active-only counts too for the admin overview.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data added; CRUD tests create TEST_ prefixed records and delete them within the same test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New backend routes: /api/testimonials, /api/team, /api/faqs, /api/blog (list/detail/CRUD). /api/site/home now returns testimonials+team. /api/dashboard stats include testimonials, blog, team, faqs. Frontend testids: home-testimonials-section, about-team-section, blog-list-section, faq-list-section. Seeded blog slug: making-room-for-the-good-stuff. Admin edit/delete buttons on CRUD tables are icon-only (no text) — use icon selectors or aria-labels for future automation.
